entities.name: Application Selection
entities.overview: The step where the user selects the category and primary blueprint type of the application being built.
entities.purpose: Define the target domain, core business model, and high-level architectural requirements of the software system.
entities.why_exists: Different applications require completely different system structures, directories, databases, and page layouts.
common_mistakes: Selecting a predefined app category and failing to specify custom workflows.
Choosing a stack that is over-engineered for the business domain.
impact_on_generation: Determines the default frontend and backend stack constraints.

architecture: Enforce directory structures matching standard enterprise application architecture templates.

entities.name: Feature Selection
entities.overview: The step where the user chooses modular functional features to bundle into the application.
entities.purpose: Establish the specific business capability requirements.
entities.why_exists: Enables modular code generation where only the requested business modules and database tables are designed.
common_mistakes: Selecting excessive features that overload the initial draft MVP.
impact_on_generation: Adds required database models and API routes.

entities.name: SaaS Dashboard Admin Panel
entities.overview: An enterprise-grade administration hub designed to aggregate core performance metrics, handle client workflows, and render data visualization panels.
business_goals: Give administrators real-time visibility into business operations metrics.
Provide user management panels and telemetry logging controls.
common_features: Bento grid metric cards with trend telemetry
security_considerations: Enforce strict JWT session token validation on all metrics endpoints.
scalability_considerations: Cache aggregate metrics computations in Redis for 10 minutes.
accessibility_considerations: Must be fully navigable using TAB focus paths.
mobile_considerations: Provide a collapsible sidebar that transitions to a bottom navigation rail on mobile.
analytics_considerations: Emit click telemetry triggers whenever key filters are modified.
implementation_guidelines: Set up a layout shell using a CSS grid with layout areas 'header sidebar main'.
anti_patterns: Direct database queries executed directly inside client-side components.

architecture: Create a layout shell with a collapsible navigation sidebar and top header bar. Use CSS Grid for the outer skeleton.
ui: Render metrics in a Bento Grid layout. Metric cards must show animated shimmer states during fetching.
backend: Build an API route '/api/dashboard/stats' returning total telemetry aggregates.
database: Define tables: users (id uuid, email varchar, role varchar), organizations (id uuid, name varchar).
security: Protect metrics routes with middleware verifying organization context and JWT authorization tokens.
accessibility: Sidebar navigation links must have aria-current values and cycle focus using Tab keys.

entities.name: E-Commerce Marketplace
entities.overview: A digital storefront application designed to showcase products, manage shopping carts, process checkout flows, and track deliveries.
business_goals: Provide a seamless client checkout experience.
Maximize conversion rates via speed and layouts.
security_considerations: Never store raw card details; offload completely to Stripe Elements.
scalability_considerations: Cache product descriptions in CDN margins.
accessibility_considerations: Ensure alt description text is set on all catalog image links.
mobile_considerations: Provide persistent bottom Checkout CTA bar on mobile screens.
analytics_considerations: Log conversions and abandoned cart events.
implementation_guidelines: Load catalog items with cursor pagination.
anti_patterns: Inline calculations of order totals on the client side without database cross-verification.

architecture: Establish directory: /src/app/shop for storefront pages, and /src/components/ui/card for products.
ui: Products must display in a dynamic CSS auto-fill grid grid container.
backend: Verify basket totals server-side by loading live item prices from DB during order compilation.
database: Define schemas: products (id uuid, title varchar, price integer), orders (id uuid, user_id uuid, total integer).
security: Verify Stripe payload signature header in webhook routes.
accessibility: Alt tags must explicitly describe product titles and image content.

entities.name: Student Management Hub
entities.overview: A specialized education management hub designed to record student profiles, track grades, calculate grade point averages, and orchestrate parent notifications.
business_goals: Provide parents with transparent real-time grading reports.
security_considerations: Enforce strict student record privacy (FERPA compliance).
scalability_considerations: Optimize grades queries using query pagination.
accessibility_considerations: Ensure high color contrast ratios on pass/fail labels.
mobile_considerations: Design compact lists for parent dashboards on mobile.
analytics_considerations: Log administrator grade edits for compliance auditing.
implementation_guidelines: Isolate teacher routes with clear routes '/teacher/*' and student/parent dashboard routes under '/portal/*'.
anti_patterns: Allowing parents to query metrics of classmates.

architecture: Structure the workspace into separate router domains: '/teacher/dashboard' and '/student/portal' to prevent layout bleed.
ui: Display a student directory list with paginated filters, search input, and expandable detail rows.
backend: Build GPA calculation algorithms on the server to output aggregates dynamically upon grade updates.
database: Create relational tables: students (id, first_name, last_name), grades (id, student_id, score).
security: Validate session metadata to block parent IDs from querying records of other students.
accessibility: Grade cells must render accessible text tags like 'A+', 'B-' with distinct high-contrast color styles.

entities.name: Attendance Tracking
entities.overview: Module to record, compute, and monitor daily attendance status of students or employees.
security_considerations: Ensure attendance status updates are immutable once confirmed.
scalability_considerations: Query logs using partition scoping on month/year.
accessibility_considerations: Status markers (present, late) must have unique icons (not just colors) for accessibility.
mobile_considerations: Provide simple checkmark sliders for touch viewports.
analytics_considerations: Track absence percentage thresholds to trigger notifications.
design_patterns: Transaction Script pattern for batch logs
anti_patterns: Overwriting previous attendance history log columns instead of appending audit rows.

architecture: Design a batch attendance logging workflow using form vectors.
ui: Build an interactive grid showing student lists on the left, and checkmark buttons representing check-in status on the right.
Style status controls: Green for Present, Red for Absent, Amber for Late. Ensure status indicators contain explicit text labels.
backend: Build an endpoint '/api/attendance/submit' that inserts multiple logs inside a database transaction.
database: Define table structure: attendance (id uuid, student_id uuid, date date, status varchar, recorded_by uuid).
security: Require 'teacher' or 'admin' roles to invoke attendance write endpoints.
accessibility: All attendance checkmark nodes must include ARIA role selectors representing present/absent states.

entities.name: Marks Calculation
entities.overview: Module to record term grades, execute weighted calculations, and report student grade point averages (GPA).
security_considerations: Prevent student tokens from editing marks records.
accessibility_considerations: Formula calculations must be documented in accessibility summaries.
design_patterns: Strategy pattern for calculating weighted averages
implementation_guidelines: Calculate term marks using configured weights: e.g. Homework = 20%, Tests = 50%, Final = 30%.
anti_patterns: Performing grade weighting math entirely on the client, risking security drift.

ui: Create a dynamic form where teachers enter scores alongside total points. Render weighted calculation outputs in real time on change events.
backend: Implement server-side logic calculating overall scores based on assignment weights: overall = sum(score/max * weight).
database: Define tables: grade_items (id uuid, name varchar, weight float), student_grades (id uuid, student_id uuid, item_id uuid, score float).
security: Write backend checks blocking non-authorized user roles from writing score entries.

entities.name: Dashboard Panel Page
entities.overview: A complete layout shell displaying business metrics, key analytics cards, and table structures in a dashboard context.

architecture: Layout structured as a two-column system: Left sidebar column (260px) and Right main content scrollable viewport.
ui: Apply modern Bento Grid configurations for widgets, maintaining a 3-column layout on desktop viewports.
accessibility: Incorporate skip-to-content links for keyboard navigators.

entities.name: Shadcn/UI Data Table
entities.overview: A robust, keyboard-navigable database presentation table using TanStack Table API conventions and Radix primitives.
accessibility_considerations: Include strict scope='col' on header elements.
Sort indicators must be announced via aria-sort tags.

architecture: Implement using TanStack Table (@tanstack/react-table) and shadcn/ui skeleton variables.
ui: Table headers should change colors on hover. Active sorted column must show a visual arrow highlight.
Use a frosted background with borders color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 60%, transparent).
accessibility: Headers must render a button element to toggle sorting. The button must have descriptive aria-label values.

entities.overview: A premium theme style evoking floating translucent container layers, neon outlines, and glowing deep backdrops.

All card containers must be styled with: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3).

entities.overview: A clean, highly readable neo-grotesque typography configuration designed specifically for high-density user interfaces.

entities.name: Users & Organization DB Schema
entities.overview: Structured SQL table definition defining standard relational entities and indexing tenant boundaries.

database: CREATE TABLE users (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR UNIQUE, password_hash VARCHAR, org_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id));

entities.name: Tasks & Projects DB Schema
entities.overview: Relational entities tracking column states, assignees, and projects metadata in tables.

database: CREATE TABLE projects (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR, creator_id UUID REFERENCES users(id));
CREATE TABLE tasks (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id), title VARCHAR, status VARCHAR, assignee_id UUID REFERENCES users(id));

entities.name: Channels & Messages DB Schema
entities.overview: Relational table structures tracking conversations and logging historical messages indexes.

database: CREATE TABLE channels (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR, is_private BOOLEAN);
CREATE TABLE messages (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, channel_id UUID REFERENCES channels(id), sender_id UUID REFERENCES users(id), text_content TEXT, sent_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());

entities.name: WebSockets Real-time Socket Server
entities.overview: Custom backend websocket dispatcher broadcasting messages and tracking active network streams.

backend: Instantiate Socket.IO module over server listener: const io = new Server(httpServer, { cors: { origin: '*' } });
Broadcast message payloads strictly matching channels: io.to(channelId).emit('message', data);
